reader.requirement: At --std 85 FACTORIAL's argument-1 must be an integer argument (an arithmetic expression that always results in an integer: integer literal, integer data item, integer function or always-integral expression), so a non-integral literal, a scaled or edited or alphanumeric item, a not-always-integral expression and a numeric function are refused, every integer form is accepted, and a negative value is a run-time value outside the permissible range whose result is undefined (§1989:A.2.2).

reader.notes: Every refusal half fires at --std 85 through the edition-blind type-6 screen (the same code 2023 runs); acceptance of literal, item, P-scaled item, ODO element, integer function, power and expression forms is correct.
